gloss_en: Rock (tzur, צוּר) — the flint-rock as a mystical bechinah in Likutey Moharan I:20: identified with the sela-rock from which speech issues and with the heart ('Rock of my heart', Ps. 73:26), the rock that was opened so waters flowed (Ps. 105:41), i.e., the heart-rock that gushes forth Torah explanations when opened by prayer; not the verb צוּר 'besiege/form', not צוֹר Tyre, and not the Divine epithet Tzur as such
